column1: # Drawdown SHAPE references for `-ddshape`, on `uni.apps.MarketSim.ddEpisodes`' definition and on
# `pctile(.., 0.5)`'s median -- the UPPER of the two middle elements of an ascending sort on an even
# count (a depth reads the shallower, a duration the longer), which is the median the model rows
# print.  NumPy averages the two, and at four episodes the conventions differ
# by up to a third of a statistic (SPY at 20%: depth -33.7 here against -40.6 averaged).  Measured
# 2026-09-02 with the model's own functions over date/price series exported from folio's caches:
#   CRSP  Ken French F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily (202606 CRSP), Mkt-RF + RF compounded: the
#   NDX   Yahoo Nasdaq-100 index close -- a PRICE index; its dividend yield runs under 1%/yr and
#         does not move a decline's shape -- 1990-01-02..2026-08-31
# The three 33-year CRSP windows are SPY's own length and each opens near a high (the fresh-start
# rule stated in episodes-2026-08-29.tsv), so their spread is what one SPY-length history can show.
# `DdShapeAnchorSuite` / `dd_shape_anchor_tests` assert both anchor sets' references against these
# rows; editing a row moves the shipped reference.
# Columns: set, series, from, to, years, thr (%), eps (episodes deeper than thr), epsPerYr, depth
# (median %), decline / recovery / underwater (median sessions; recovery over recovered episodes
# only), worstDay (median share of the log decline in its worst session), recovered (episode count
# with a recovery -- the rest were still underwater at the window's end).
